chapter_title: Concerning Food: It shall be allocated to Five Pro
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:** The various knowledges of good and truth that a person receives inwardly and appropriates into the mind are distributed into five distinct spiritual productions.

**¶3:** The first production is what proceeds from the person as interior joy, and it ascends into wisdom; it flows forth from every faculty and capacity of the spiritual person, and it is without measure or limit.

**¶4:** The second is what proceeds from the person as the outward expression of affection and the communication of truth through doctrine.

**¶5:** The third is what arises from them as spiritual power and the performance of uses.

**¶6:** The fourth is what is generated by the delight of self-love in the will and the understanding acting from their natural proprium.

**¶7:** The fifth is what is formed and impressed upon the outermost natural life, and is brought forth from them. This is the external sensual person. Only the will and the understanding that produced it recognize the thing they have generated. They attend continually to its desire, its thought, and its love, at every moment. But the other four spiritual productions they neither perceive nor regard — because these are not manifest to the natural senses.

---

*Note on the architecture of the passage:* The teaching describes a descending order — from interior celestial joy (¶3), through communication of truth (¶4), through active use (¶5), through natural self-love (¶6), to the outermost corporeal formation (¶7). The final observation is that the unregenerate mind attends only to the lowest, most external product, entirely unaware of the four interior realities that the same spiritual nourishment also brings forth. This corresponds precisely to what Swedenborg calls the inversion of order in the natural person, who sees only effects and is blind to causes.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This sustenance of various kinds that people gather in and eat, and enters the body; it shall be distributed to five productions.
The first product is this that shall issue from the person in rapture and rises up in the Mind, and it comes out from all his limbs, and is immeasurable.
The second is this that shall issue from the person in voice and word.
The third is this that shall spring from them in strength and activity.
The fourth is what is engendered by the pleasure of lu[s]t in men and women.

The fifth is this that shall be formed and sculpted in the flesh, and be engendered and come from them. It is this corporeal creature; only its parents can recognise this creature that they beget. They are attentive to its desire and its thought and its [lo]ve every day, all the time. However, these other four forms they neither notice nor are concerned about; because they are not displayed.
